games.name: GET OUT [PRE ALPHA]
games.desc:
You weren't meant to survive. You have to GET OUT.

A 2000s retro extraction shooter.

You know what you have to do. 
Deploy, loot, and shoot your way to GET OUT.

- PvPvE extraction runs
- Guns, attachments, armor, skins
- Helicopters and drivable vehicles
- Arcadey systems with a grounded sense of realism
- NO HUNGER, NO STAMINA, AND NO ZOMBIES

This is a solo project still in infancy. GET OUT is visually inspired by titles such as DRIV3R (2004) and SWAT 3 (1999). It is not for sale.
(PS - I am the guy on the thumbnails. Yes I am a LARPer)

games.name: The Backrooms | ASYNC
games.desc:
AdySYNC

- Inspired by The Backrooms Wiki, K. Pixels, Apeirophobia and Liminal Spaces across the whole world.

games.name: [UPDATE 3] SPIKED
games.desc:
"Someone who can't see the opponent standing right in front of him, can't defeat the opponent that lies beyond!"

Create plays and dominate in your position. Choose the impact you want to make in SPIKED, a Roblox Volleyball game inspired by Haikyuu.

(It is recommended to play SPIKED with keyboard and mouse)

MOBILE IS HEAVILY A WORK IN PROGRESS!

PLAYER CONTROLS:

RMB - BUMP STANCE
LMB (IN BUMP STANCE) - Receive
LMB (MID-AIR) - Spike
RMB (MID-AIR) - Block
LMB (DURING SERVE) - Floater Serve
RMB (DURING SERVE) - Jump serve
Space - Jump (CHARGABLE)
Shift - Sprint
Q - Dive
V - Hold to recharge stamina
T - The Zone
1 - Weapon 1
2 - Weapon 2
F - Set forwards
R - Set backwards
M - Menu

Tags: Haikyuu, Haikyuu!!, Volleyball, VB, SPIKED
